summary.en: The camera winds back and crashes into one card; three frames of negative with focus lines hit, then the clean close-up shakes still.
summary.zh: 镜头先往后收、再急推撞进一张卡；撞停的三帧画面翻成负片、炸出集中线，随后干净的特写抖几下停稳。

fits: The one hit of a film: a card, a number or a word that lands as the climax, on the drop.
notFor: Anything but the single peak; paper and ink styles (use plate-slip); calm or serious products.

intent.en: The film's one hit lands with force: three negative frames bite into time, so the viewer feels the blow rather than sees a picture.
intent.zh: 全片唯一的一拳打实：三帧负片把时间咬住，观众感到的是冲击力，而不是看到一张图。

content.en: The scene and one target card in it (its rect): a card, a number or a word that is the climax; no extra text.
content.zh: 场景和其中一张目标卡（给出位置框）：作为高潮的卡片、数字或词；不需要额外文字。

fits.zh: 全片唯一的那一击：作为高潮的卡片、数字或词，落在音乐的 drop 上。

notFor.zh: 除那一个高潮以外的任何地方；纸墨风格（用 plate-slip）；调性安静或严肃的产品。

en: Once a film, at the peak; a second one makes the punch a habit. Never with whiteout-slam or plate-slip in one film.
The negative frames must land with an impact sound on the same frame; silent, they read as a broken frame.
Do not stack it with another time remap (freeze, speed ramp) in the same shot.
zh: 一支片只用一次、用在高潮；第二次就成了习惯。不和 whiteout-slam、plate-slip 同片。
负片帧必须和撞击音效同帧落下，无声的负片读成坏帧。
同一镜头别再叠别的时间重映射（顿帧、变速）。
